scope: common valid cases across ten judges, paired across explanation conditions

policies.recall95: maximize validation precision subject to validation recall >= 0.95
policies.precision95: maximize validation recall subject to validation precision >= 0.95 and at least 20 raw validation predicted positives

thresholds: existing frozen probe grid and judge integer thresholds 0..100
tie_break: highest probe threshold then highest judge threshold within 1e-12 objective ties
infeasible: record unavailable; never substitute unconstrained solution
comparison: Within each backbone-judge pair, average over identical datasets feasible for all 3 conditions. Record dataset coverage; no test feasibility filtering.
evaluation: Frozen validation-selected cutoffs on matched weighted test cases; 95 percent is a validation point-estimate target, not a guarantee. No new model calls.
